title: XTEND and JFB Construction Holdings Business Combination Expected to Close This Week
summary: JFB Construction Holdings and XTEND announced that their business combination is on track to close on September 3, 2026. The combined company will be renamed XTEND AI Robotics, Inc., and its stock is expected to begin trading on the NYSE under the ticker "XTND" on September 4, 2026. This merger will support XTEND's growth in AI-powered robotics for defense, law enforcement, and security sectors.

title: Carparts.com CEO David Meniane buys $85,802 in company stock
summary: Carparts.com CEO David Meniane purchased $85,802 worth of the company's common stock in late August 2026, increasing his direct ownership to 219,875 shares. This insider buying follows a period of stock appreciation and comes as the company reported a smaller-than-expected loss and exceeded revenue forecasts for Q2 2026, indicating strategic shifts and improved financial health.

title: StoneX (SNEX) Doubled From Its Lows as Trading Activity Surged — Can the Growth Continue?
summary: Riverwater Partners' Small Cap Strategy highlighted StoneX Group Inc. (SNEX) as its largest contributor in Q2 2026, with shares gaining approximately 47% during the quarter. This performance was driven by elevated market volatility and strong trading activity. Despite trimming its position due to valuation concerns, Riverwater Partners still considers SNEX a durable compounder, though they also note that certain AI stocks may offer greater upside potential with less downside risk.

title: Franklin Templeton Inc. stock underperforms Tuesday when compared to competitors
summary: Franklin Templeton Inc. (BEN) stock fell 3.07% to $33.10 on Tuesday, marking its fifth consecutive day of losses. This underperformance occurred during a generally negative trading session, with the S&P 500 Index and Dow Jones Industrial Average also experiencing declines. The article highlights the stock's struggle in comparison to its competitors and the broader market trends.

title: PureCycle Technologies Extends $200 Million Revolving Credit Facility Maturity to 2028
summary: PureCycle Technologies, Inc. announced an extension of its $200 million Revolving Credit Facility's maturity date from September 30, 2027, to September 30, 2028. This extension, formalized via the Twelfth Amendment to the Credit Agreement, also includes a maturity extension fee. The lenders, Sylebra Capital Partners Master Fund, LTD and Sylebra Capital Menlo Master Fund, hold over 5% beneficial ownership in PureCycle.

title: Q-and-A with Mark Salman, CEO, Midera Food Processing, Inc.
summary: Midera Food Processing, Inc. recently spun off from The Middleby Corporation, becoming an independent public company. CEO Mark Salman explains that the spinoff will allow Midera to focus more intently on its single strategy, benefiting both customers in the meat and poultry industry and shareholders. He emphasizes that the company will prioritize customer needs, accelerate innovation, and enhance aftermarket support to provide the best total line solutions.

title: PowerBank (NASDAQ: PBK) Secures Development Deal for Ontario Battery Storage Project
summary: PowerBank Corporation has finalized a fee-for-service development agreement for a battery energy storage project in Ontario, including a potential site in Hamilton. If the project secures a contract from the IESO, PowerBank will manage its development, permitting, and retain a right of first refusal for engineering, procurement, and construction services. This deal positions PowerBank to play a significant role in expanding Ontario's electricity grid capacity.

title: Ford to Pay $2.3 Million to Settle Racial Harassment EEOC Claim
summary: Ford Motor Company has agreed to pay $2.3 million to settle a racial harassment claim brought by the U.S. Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC). The settlement addresses allegations that employees at Ford's Buffalo, New York, stamping plant were subjected to racially targeted graffiti. The EEOC's investigation found that Black, Native American, and Hispanic workers experienced discrimination and harassment, violating Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964.

title: (HCC) Risk Channels and Responsive Allocation
summary: This article provides an in-depth analysis of Warrior Met Coal Inc. (NYSE: HCC), highlighting strong sentiment and an overweight bias across all trading horizons. It details institutional trading strategies, including position, momentum breakout, and risk hedging, along with multi-timeframe signal analysis to optimize position sizing and minimize drawdown risk. title: Ashland to host Innovation Day for analysts and investors
summary: Ashland Inc. (NYSE: ASH) will host a virtual Innovation Day on September 17, 2026, for analysts and investors, providing an updated view of its technology platforms, commercial progress, and scalability. The event will feature presentations from Ashland executives and senior technology leaders, detailing innovations poised to impact key markets and drive organic growth. Participants will also have a moderated Q&A session.

title: Relmada Therapeutics to Participate at the Wells Fargo 21st Annual Healthcare Conference
summary: Relmada Therapeutics, a clinical-stage biotechnology company, announced its senior management will participate in one-on-one meetings at the Wells Fargo 21st Annual Healthcare Conference in Boston from September 8-10, 2026. The company focuses on developing therapies for oncology and central nervous system disorders, with lead candidates NDV-01 and sepranolone. Interested parties are encouraged to contact their Wells Fargo representative to arrange a meeting.

title: Healthcare cyberattacks hit pacemakers and millions of patient records
summary: Two major healthcare companies, Boston Scientific and McKesson, have disclosed details about separate cyberattacks. Boston Scientific's attack has affected pacemakers' remote monitoring capabilities, while McKesson confirmed a breach where ShinyHunters claims to have stolen millions of patient records and is demanding a $55.2 million ransom. Both companies are working on restoring systems and investigating the incidents.

title: Remitly CBO Pankaj Sharma sells $554k in company stock
summary: Pankaj Sharma, Chief Business Officer at Remitly Global, Inc. (NASDAQ:RELY), sold 21,000 shares of company stock worth $554,190 on August 28, 2026, as part of a pre-arranged trading plan. This sale occurred while Remitly shares were near their 52-week high, having seen significant gains. The company recently reported strong Q2 2026 earnings, leading to increased price targets from analysts.

title: Las Vegas Sands increases ownership stake in Macau subsidiary Sands China above 75%
summary: Las Vegas Sands Corp (LVS) has increased its ownership stake in its Macau subsidiary, Sands China Ltd, to 75.1% through a recent open market purchase of shares. This transaction, valued at approximately HK$22.4 million (US$2.85 million), brings LVS's stake above 75%, causing Sands China to switch its compliance with Hong Kong listing rules from the Initial Prescribed Threshold to the Alternative Threshold. LVS has been progressively increasing its investment in Sands China, demonstrating confidence in its Asia-based operations.

title: Why Revolution Medicines, the Drugmaker Behind a Pancreatic Cancer Breakthrough, Stayed Independent
summary: Revolution Medicines, a biotech company, chose to remain independent despite takeover interest, a decision that proved successful with the FDA approval of its pancreatic cancer pill, Rasonque (daraxonrasib). The company, which previously had no drugs on the market, focused on promising research that has now led to a significant breakthrough for adults with metastatic pancreatic cancer.

title: Fastly CTO Artur Bergman Reports Sale of 851 Shares and Transfers 52,603 Shares to Revocable Trust
summary: Fastly CTO and Director Artur Bergman reported selling 851 shares of Class A Common Stock on August 27, 2026, to cover tax obligations from vested Restricted Stock Units. He subsequently transferred 52,603 shares to the Per Artur Bergman Revocable Trust on August 28, 2026, shifting them from direct to indirect ownership. Following these transactions, Bergman directly holds 1,920,050 shares and indirectly owns an additional 3,607,255 shares across six trusts.

title: Prudential Financial stock hits 52-week low at 20.31 USD By Investing.com
summary: Prudential Financial (NYSE: PRS) stock has reached a new 52-week low at $20.31, marking a significant drop from its high of $25.19. The company's stock has declined by 12.4% over the past year, attributed to challenges within the financial sector and broader market conditions. This downturn is occurring amidst fluctuating economic indicators and investor sentiment.

title: CVB Financial Director Mike Maddox Acquires 10,000 Shares at $22.03 Each
summary: CVB Financial Director Mike Maddox has acquired 10,000 shares of CVB Financial Corp common stock at $22.03 per share on August 31, 2026. This open-market purchase, revealed in a Form 4 filed with the SEC, increases Maddox's direct beneficial ownership to 13,138 common shares. The transaction indicates a director's increased stake in the company.

title: Inflection Point Acquisition V Lifts Sponsor Share Lock-Ups
summary: Inflection Point Acquisition Corp. V (IPEX) and GOWell have removed lock-up restrictions on 3.34 million PubCo shares for their sponsors and underwriting representatives, making them freely tradable post-merger. This change, announced ahead of a September 3, 2026 shareholder vote, was reflected in an updated proxy statement that also detailed new redemption timing and warned of potential dilution and conflicts of interest for non-redeeming shareholders. Inflection Point is a SPAC that went public in February 2025 and is targeting a merger with GOWell Technology Limited and GOWell Energy Technology.

title: American Tower (NYSE:AMT) Raises Guidance As Data-Center Leasing Hits Records
summary: American Tower (NYSE:AMT) has raised its full-year guidance for the second time, driven by record data-center leasing and consistent demand from its global tower estate. The company's dual model of communications real estate and interconnected data centers positions it favorably amidst surging digital demand and the AI buildout. This positive outlook contrasts with the broader real estate trust market, which is more sensitive to interest rate fluctuations.

title: Johnson Lau Steps Down as VP of Finance at SL Science Holding Ltd
summary: Johnson Lau (Shun-Pong) has resigned from his position as Vice President of Finance at SL Science Holding Ltd (NASDAQ: SLBT), effective August 31, 2026. This resignation also means he is no longer subject to Section 16 reporting requirements. The filing indicated no securities transactions occurred, only a change in his reporting status.

title: Ryder System EVP Robert D. Fatovic Gifts 403 Shares, Updates Ownership Stake
summary: Robert D. Fatovic, EVP, Chief Legal Officer, and Corporate Secretary of Ryder System Inc, gifted 403 shares of common stock on August 28, 2026. This transaction, recorded at no monetary exchange, updated his direct beneficial ownership to 88,455 shares. Fatovic also maintains indirect holdings through company savings and deferred compensation plans, with no changes to derivative securities.

title: Entegris, Penguin Solutions, Teradyne, Applied Materials, and KLA Corporation Stocks Trade Down, What You Need To Know
summary: Several semiconductor-related stocks, including Entegris, Penguin Solutions, Teradyne, Applied Materials, and KLA Corporation, experienced declines after surging crude oil prices and rising Treasury yields sparked inflation concerns and increased corporate borrowing costs. The market reaction was attributed to the U.S. military striking Iranian targets, leading to higher oil prices and a climb in the 10-year Treasury yield, which negatively impacts the cost of capital and profit margins in the chip supply chain. Despite the current dip, some of these stocks, like Teradyne, have shown significant gains year-to-date.

title: Perella Weinberg Files Prospectus for Shareholder Stock Resale
summary: Perella Weinberg Partners (PWP) has filed a prospectus supplement with the SEC to allow certain stockholders to resell 1,127,529 shares of its Class A common stock. This move provides liquidity options for existing shareholders without issuing new equity. The stock currently has a "Buy" rating from analysts with a $21.00 price target, while TipRanks’ AI Analyst, Spark, rates PWP as Neutral due to mixed fundamentals and valuation concerns.

title: BiomX Rebrands as Tessera Defense and Homeland Security
summary: BiomX is rebranding as Tessera Defense and Homeland Security Inc., effective September 11, 2026, with its stock ticker changing from PHGE to HLSQ on the NYSE American. This change signifies a complete pivot into integrated defense and homeland security technologies, focusing on threat detection and AI-powered analysis for critical infrastructure. Despite the strategic positives of this move, TipRanks' AI Analyst, Spark, rates PHGE as Neutral due to weak financial performance and bearish technicals, though a recent analyst rating is a Buy with a $26.00 price target.

title: Cadence Design Systems (CDNS) Falls More Steeply Than Broader Market: What Investors Need to Know
summary: Cadence Design Systems (CDNS) shares dropped 7.6% while the S&P 500 lost 0.71%, underperforming the broader market. Despite this, the company's shares have seen a slight increase over the last month, though lagging its sector. Investors are anticipating its upcoming earnings report, with expectations of increased EPS and revenue compared to the prior year.

title: Short Interest in Rithm Property Trust Inc. (NYSE:RPT) Drops By 33.7%
summary: Short interest in Rithm Property Trust Inc. (NYSE:RPT) significantly decreased by 33.7% in August, falling to 181,074 shares as of August 14th. This reduction brings the days-to-cover ratio to 2.6 days and means 2.3% of the company's shares are now sold short. The company recently reported better-than-expected quarterly earnings and pays an annualized dividend yield of 11.5%.

title: Mohawk Industries Appoints An Nuyttens as President of Flooring Rest of the World Segment
summary: Mohawk Industries announced the appointment of An Nuyttens as President of its Flooring Rest of the World segment, effective mid-October 2026. Ms. Nuyttens brings over 30 years of global leadership experience from Solvay. This appointment comes as Paul De Cock, who previously held the interim role, is set to become Mohawk Industries' Chief Executive Officer on September 30, 2026.

title: Ares Raises ¥612B for Japan Logistics Fund
summary: Ares Management Corp has successfully closed Japan Logistics Development Partners V LP, raising ¥612 billion ($3.8 billion) for logistics development in Japan. This fund is the largest closed-end institutional raise for Ares' real estate platform, exceeding its 2021 predecessor by almost 50%. The strategy focuses on building institutional-grade modern logistics facilities in major Japanese metropolitan areas, with significant backing from investors including Canada Pension Plan Investment Board.

title: Nova Ltd CFO Guy Kizner Receives 1,297 RSUs, Raises Total Shareholding to 6,981
summary: Nova Ltd's CFO, Guy Kizner, received 1,297 restricted share units (RSUs) at no cost on September 1, 2026, as per a Form 4 filing with the SEC. This grant increases his total direct beneficial ownership to 6,981 ordinary shares. The RSUs will vest in equal annual installments through 2030, contingent on his continued service to the company.

title: Doximity Director Kevin Spain Granted 8,084 RSUs as Reported in SEC Filing
summary: Doximity Director Kevin Spain was granted 8,084 restricted stock units (RSUs) on August 27, 2026, as disclosed in an SEC Form 4 filing. These RSUs, part of Doximity's non-employee director compensation plan, vest on the earlier of the first anniversary of the grant date or the company's next annual stockholders meeting. Following this grant, Spain directly holds 11,305 shares and has significant indirect ownership through a family trust and Emergence Capital, while disclaiming beneficial ownership for shares held by these entities except for his pecuniary interest.

title: Doximity Director Phoebe L. Yang Watkin Awarded 8,084 RSUs on August 27, 2026
summary: Doximity, Inc. director Phoebe L. Yang Watkin was granted 8,084 restricted stock units (RSUs) on August 27, 2026, as reported in a beneficial ownership filing on August 31, 2026. These RSUs, part of Doximity's non-employee director compensation policy, will vest on the earlier of the first anniversary of the grant or the company’s next annual stockholders meeting, provided she remains a director. Post-grant, Yang Watkin beneficially owns 26,034 shares of Class A Common Stock.

title: Deere launches AI assistant named JD to guide farmers’ choices
summary: Deere & Co. has launched an AI assistant named JD within its Operations Center mobile application to help farmers analyze the vast amounts of data collected by their high-tech tractors. This tool aims to assist farmers in making informed decisions throughout the growing season, such as optimizing fertilizer use, and will be free for app users. Deere also emphasized its "farmer data commitment," assuring growers that their information is controlled by them and never sold.

title: Moderna Raises $3 Billion via Convertible Notes Offering
summary: Moderna successfully raised $3.0 billion through a private offering of 0.00% Convertible Senior Notes due 2032, providing non-dilutive capital and financial flexibility. The notes, with an initial conversion price of approximately $210.58 per share, allow for conversion into cash, stock, or a combination. The company utilized a portion of the proceeds for capped call transactions to mitigate shareholder dilution and plans to use the remaining funds for general corporate purposes, including investments in oncology growth and debt repayment.

title: Flag Ship Acquisition Transfers Listing to Nasdaq Capital Market
summary: Flag Ship Acquisition Corp. (FSHP), a SPAC, has received Nasdaq approval to transfer its securities listing from The Nasdaq Global Market to The Nasdaq Capital Market, effective September 2, 2026. This move aims to ensure continued compliance with Nasdaq listing standards and does not change the company's reporting obligations under the Securities Exchange Act. The company focuses on raising capital through its listed securities for future business combinations.

title: FPL Launches New Assistance Center, Making It Easier for Customers to Find Ways to Get Help and Save
summary: Florida Power & Light Company (FPL) has launched a new online Assistance Center to help customers find programs for saving energy, managing bills, and accessing additional support. This center introduces "FPL Saving Steps," a new program offering eligible customers a one-time $200 bill credit for reducing energy use. It also consolidates various FPL programs, federal aid, energy-saving education, and local nonprofit resources to provide comprehensive support for customers.

title: Camping World Holdings Secures $175 Million Amended Mortgage Loan Facility
summary: Camping World Holdings, through its indirect subsidiaries, has secured a $175 million Amended and Restated Credit Agreement for senior secured mortgage loan facilities. This agreement, effective August 25, 2026, refinances a previous 2022 facility and extends the maturity date to August 25, 2031. The facilities provide initial funding of $132.8 million, with an additional $20.8 million drawn, and include options for delayed draws and increased borrowing capacity.

title: Novartis, Bristol Myers Squibb pause CAR-T trials for lupus and other autoimmune diseases for safety reviews
summary: Novartis and Bristol Myers Squibb have temporarily halted their clinical trials for CAR-T cell therapies in lupus and other autoimmune diseases to conduct safety reviews. Novartis paused trials after three participants in rap-cel studies died from complications of a rare inflammatory reaction. Bristol Myers Squibb voluntarily paused enrollment in zola-cel trials as a precaution after observing transient inflammatory events, though the company maintains confidence in the therapy.

title: Navan CEO Ariel Cohen Executes Sale of 393,378 Shares in August 2026 Under 10b5-1 Plan
summary: Navan CEO Ariel M. Cohen sold a total of 393,378 shares of Class A Common Stock in August 2026, including direct sales and sales from three GST Trusts, all executed under a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan. The sales occurred at a weighted average price of $30.1441, with individual transaction prices ranging from $30.00 to $30.66. Prior to the sales, the GST Trusts converted Class B shares to Class A shares at no cost.

title: Investors Title Director Tammy Coley Exercises 363 Stock Appreciation Rights to Acquire Common Shares
summary: Investors Title Co. director Tammy Coley exercised three tranches of stock appreciation rights on August 27, 2026, acquiring a total of 363 common shares. This transaction increased her direct ownership in the company to 1,851 common shares. The Form 4 filing, submitted on August 31, 2026, details the conversion of these derivative securities into common stock at various exercise prices.

title: ASPEN-09-03 Trial Aims to Build the Case for Evorpacept in Post–T-DXd HER2+ Breast Cancer
summary: The ASPEN-09-03 trial is investigating evorpacept in combination with trastuzumab and chemotherapy for patients with HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer who have progressed after T-DXd treatment. This phase 2 study aims to build upon previous findings suggesting that CD47 expression and ctDNA assays can help identify patients most likely to benefit. The trial seeks to establish CD47 as a crucial biomarker, potentially expanding treatment options beyond current HER2-status-only approaches, and interim data are expected in Q3 2026.

title: Palo Alto Networks (PANW) Tops Q4 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
summary: Palo Alto Networks (PANW) exceeded Q4 earnings and revenue estimates, reporting $1.02 per share against a Zacks Consensus Estimate of $0.98, and revenues of $3.41 billion. This marks the fourth consecutive quarter the company has surpassed both EPS and revenue expectations. The stock has seen significant growth this year, adding about 107.5%, and currently holds a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy), indicating expected market outperformance.

title: Dollar Tree Insider Sold Shares Worth $315,025, According to a Recent SEC Filing
summary: An insider at Dollar Tree (DLTR) recently sold shares valued at $315,025, as reported in a new SEC filing. The article, published on September 1, 2026, references this transaction and other recent analyst adjustments to Dollar Tree's price targets and ratings. Dollar Tree, Inc. is a leading American discount retailer operating over 9,000 stores in the US and Canada.

title: [U.S. Stocks] Dow Inc falls for third straight day, down $419 = Amid concerns over escalating U.S.-Iran conflict (1st) ☆ Replacement
summary: Dow Inc. (DOW) experienced a significant decline, falling $4.19 and marking its third consecutive day of losses. This downturn is attributed to growing concerns about an escalating conflict between the United States and Iran, impacting investor confidence. The stock's performance reflects broader market anxieties over geopolitical instability.

title: BMW Sues Broadcom Over Patent Dispute
summary: BMW has filed a lawsuit in a U.S. court against Broadcom, seeking a declaration that its vehicles do not infringe on Broadcom's automotive Ethernet and Wi-Fi patents. This action escalates an ongoing licensing dispute, with BMW claiming Broadcom is demanding significantly higher royalty rates after their previous agreement expired. Broadcom's subsidiary Avago had previously sued BMW in Germany over related European patents.

title: Motto by Hilton Opens Second Mexico Property in Guadalajara
summary: Motto by Hilton has opened its second property in Mexico, the 154-room Motto by Hilton Guadalajara Centro Histórico, owned and developed by Grupo Megaterra. This opening is part of a larger trend of strengthening U.S. lodging fundamentals, with RevPAR forecast to rise 5.1% in 2026, driven by corporate transient demand and events like the World Cup. The article also highlights various other hotel deal, development, and technology news within the industry.

title: Raymond James initiates Southern Missouri Bancorp stock coverage at Market Perform
summary: Raymond James has initiated coverage on Southern Missouri Bancorp (SMBC) with a Market Perform rating, noting the bank's strong organic growth and strategic acquisitions, which have expanded its regional presence. The firm views the current risk/reward as balanced, as the stock's improved profitability is already reflected in its re-rated shares. Despite near-term moderation in growth expectations due to funding priorities and fading margin tailwinds, continued capital accumulation and potential M&A provide longer-term optionality for SMBC.

title: Melco parent books slight revenue growth to US$2.6 billion in 1H26 but profit down 11.8% on higher costs
summary: Melco International Development Limited reported a 2.7% increase in net revenues to US$2.62 billion for the first half of 2026, driven by improved gaming operations. However, profit attributable to owners decreased by 11.8% to US$39.5 million, and Adjusted EBITDA fell by 5.8% due to higher operating costs and impairments. Group Chairman and CEO Lawrence Ho attributed the moderation in performance to near-term headwinds in Q2 but highlighted ongoing strategic investments and operational efficiencies across its global properties.
